changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
create or alter view [dbo].[SiteNavFlat] as select u.ObjectID, u.[Class], u.Name, u.url as Route, u.Object, null as SortOrder, u.ParentID as ParentID from ( select T.ObjectID, T.[Class], null as ParentID, T.Name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url, 'ArtifactType' as [Object] FROM AssetType T where T.[Object] = 'ArtifactType'
UNION ALL
SELECT T.ObjectID, T.[Class], null as ParentID, T.Name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url, 'TaxonomyType' as [Object] FROM AssetType T WHERE T.[Object] = 'TaxonomyType'
UNION ALL
SELECT T.ObjectID, T.[Class], null as ParentID, T.Name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url, 'PolicyType' as [Object] FROM AssetType T WHERE T.[Object] = 'PolicyType' ) u
